frequency_question: What proportion of threatened or officially announced sweeping tariffs on major trade partners are implemented on schedule rather than delayed, withdrawn, or resolved via a deal within the specified timeframe?
membership_rule: Includes official announcements of broad tariff measures by a major economy targeting a specific trade partner with a defined implementation window of 3 to 12 months. Excludes minor antidumping duties or sector-specific technical tariffs.
window: 3 to 12 months from announcement to implementation date
